title: Microsoft Teams: download manager with improved visibility and control
summary: The roadmap details, product-level licensing and qualified documentation gaps are supported. However, the assertion that no spending cap or budget control applies goes beyond the evidence: finding no documented meter does not establish that financial controls are inapplicable.
